# inquires into

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:inquiresInto`](gmeow-inquiresInto.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/inquiresInto>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inquiry`](../../slices/inquiry.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent actively pursues an answer to a question — the investigative attitude, committing inquiry effort, stronger than merely asking or wondering. Range OPEN, like [`gmeow:asks`](gmeow-asks.md). Non-functional. The effort and its vantage ride the statement; resolution is an epistemics acceptance, never a truth bit here.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record that an agent is actively investigating a question — committing inquiry effort to find an answer — the investigative attitude that drives a research queue.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for mere idle entertaining (use [`gmeow:wondersWhether`](gmeow-wondersWhether.md)) and for the directed, resolution-aimed case where an epistemics state is the explicit target (use [`gmeow:seeksToKnow`](gmeow-seeksToKnow.md)); inquiry is the activity, not yet the achieved knowing.

### How to use

- Point the agent at the question under investigation; carry the vantage on [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) of the statement, promote to [`gmeow:InquiryTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InquiryTenure.md) when the inquiry's lifecycle is itself the fact, and mark resolution by an [`gmeow:accepts`](gmeow-accepts.md) / [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) over an gmeow:answers-claim.

### Scope notes

- A question is OPEN for the agent until the agent [`gmeow:accepts`](gmeow-accepts.md) / [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) an gmeow:answers-claim for it; resolution REUSES the epistemics spine, so there is no new 'resolved' term ([Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6)). Reopening closes the prior accepted answer with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)), never deletion.
